notes: Store meta: STATE Bags, New York, USD; 'STATE designs fashionable bags for school, travel, work & play' (https://statebags.com/meta.json). Product pages: Kane Backpack, 'our best-selling kids' backpack', recommended kindergarten to third grade, 45% recycled materials; Luna Mini Crossbody 90% recycled (products.json).
